pairs.answer: Pick Netflix for a bigger original library and 4K; pick Hulu (ideally in the Disney+ bundle) for next-day TV episodes. With ads, Netflix is cheaper at $8.99 versus $12.49, but the $12.99 Disney+, Hulu bundle gives you two services.
points: Price with ads: Netflix $8.99, Hulu $12.49.
Ad-free: Netflix Standard $19.99, Hulu Premium $21.49.
Hulu gets many network and FX episodes the day after they air; Netflix focuses on originals and licensed seasons.
Only Hulu offers a live TV package (Hulu + Live TV).

pairs.answer: Netflix suits mixed adult households; Disney+ suits families with kids and franchise fans. Ad plans cost $8.99 (Netflix) and $12.49 (Disney+), and ad-free is $19.99 versus $21.49.
points: Disney+ carries Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars and National Geographic.
Netflix has a broader mix of genres and international originals.
Disney+ is cheaper as part of the Disney+, Hulu bundle ($12.99 with ads).

pairs.answer: HBO Max is the better value for prestige drama and Warner Bros. films, with a $10.99 ad plan and $18.49 ad-free. Netflix has a larger library overall and a cheaper ad plan at $8.99.
points: Ad-free: HBO Max Standard $18.49 versus Netflix Standard $19.99.
4K: HBO Max Premium $22.99 versus Netflix Premium $26.99.
HBO Max offers annual billing; Netflix does not.

pairs.answer: Both are low-cost sports-and-network services. Paramount+ is cheaper ad-free ($13.99 versus $19.99) and has Champions League soccer and NFL on CBS; Peacock Premium ($12.99) has NBC shows, Sunday Night Football and NBA games.
points: Cheapest plan: Peacock Select $8.99 (no sports), Paramount+ Essential $8.99.
Live local station: Peacock Premium Plus includes NBC; Paramount+ Premium includes CBS.
Pick by network: NBC and Bravo fans choose Peacock, CBS fans choose Paramount+.

pairs.answer: If you already pay for Amazon Prime, Prime Video costs nothing extra (with ads) and Netflix is the add-on to judge. Ad-free, Netflix Standard is $19.99 while Prime plus Ultra is $19.98 and includes shipping benefits.
points: Prime Video standalone is $8.99, the same as Netflix with ads.
Prime Video has Thursday Night Football and NBA games; Netflix has occasional live events.
Netflix has the larger original library.

pairs.answer: Apple TV is a smaller, all-original, ad-free service at $14.99 with 4K included. Netflix costs less with ads ($8.99) but $26.99 for 4K. Many people rotate Apple TV in for a month when a show they want lands.
points: Apple TV includes 4K on its only plan; Netflix reserves 4K for Premium.
Netflix has a far larger catalog.
Apple TV includes MLS matches starting in 2026.

pairs.answer: For live TV, YouTube TV ($82.99) and Hulu + Live TV ($99.99 with Disney+ and ESPN Select) both carry local networks and ESPN. YouTube TV is cheaper and has unlimited DVR; Hulu + Live TV includes the Disney streaming bundle.
points: YouTube TV sells cheaper genre plans from $64.99.
Hulu + Live TV includes Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Select at no extra cost.
NFL Sunday Ticket is an add-on only for YouTube TV.

pairs.answer: YouTube TV is the full cable replacement with local channels for $82.99. Sling TV is the budget option at $45.99 per base plan, but it has few local stations, so plan on an antenna.
points: Sling Orange & Blue together: $60.99.
YouTube TV includes unlimited DVR.
Sling has $19.99 mini plans; YouTube TV's smallest plan is $64.99.

pairs.answer: Both are full live TV services. YouTube TV is cheaper ($82.99 versus Fubo Pro at $88.99) and has unlimited DVR; Fubo is built for sports and carries regional sports networks in some markets.
points: Fubo Elite: $98.99.
Fubo first-month discounts were shown on its welcome page.
Check your ZIP code on both sites: local and regional channels vary.

pairs.answer: Philo ($25) is cheaper but has no sports or news networks. Sling ($45.99) costs more but includes ESPN (Orange) or a broader lineup (Blue). Choose Philo only if you never watch sports.
points: Neither includes most local channels; both pair with an antenna.
Sling's $19.99 mini plans are an option if you need only a few channels.
